items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: they had Ray Miller there... So Fagan says, you fellas are great... I said, I can't start. He says, well where did you come here from? I said, my agent sent me.

ctx.x: What years would you say that they started with a real distinctive big band style? Would it be about like the late twenties, or somewhere in there?

I would say the middle twenties. Middle twenties? Yes, yes. Duke Ellington and such, you know, and Ray Miller. You see, as I told you, I signed up with Vincent Lopez's office. Not that I needed a job, because I was working. But it's good to have somebody looking out for your interest, you know.
